segments.text: My boyfriend just posted about my period online and people are freaking out. 11 million people saw it and I just don't understand why it's such a big deal. People are calling my boyfriend weird and strange for this, but we actually want to change the narrative around menstrual blood and part of that is collecting my menstrual blood to do all kinds of experiments. How many microplastics do I have in my blood? Can we create new treatments to treat my endometriosis? This is really important health science. So, I'm really proud that Brian was posting about my period and it's kind of an amazing sign if your man knows where you're at in your cycle.
